--- title: "09 · Variant Frequency + Shannon Entropy" subtitle: "Intra-host variant frequency scatter, Shannon entropy curves, and caller-overlap Venn diagrams" description: | LoFreq and iVar variant calls across days post-infection (DPI). Variant frequency scatter plots with gene-boundary annotation, genome-wide Shannon entropy trajectories with SEM ribbons, and caller-overlap Venn diagrams to quantify agreement. categories: [genomics, virology, variant-calling, entropy, Shannon, LoFreq, iVar] jupyter: python3 --- ## Overview | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Input** | CSV variant tables: `LoFreq_variants.csv`, `iVar_variants.csv`, `gene_coords.csv`, `manifest.csv` | | **Key packages** | `pandas`, `numpy`, `matplotlib`, `scipy`, `matplotlib_venn` (optional) | | **Statistics** | Shannon entropy (natural log) · Allele frequency filtering · Caller overlap | | **Output** | Variant frequency scatter (SVG/PNG) · Entropy curves (SVG/PNG) · Venn diagram (SVG/PNG) | | **Download** | [template.ipynb](template.ipynb) | Edit `FILTER_MIN_DP` and `FILTER_MIN_AF` to set depth and allele-frequency cut-offs. Modify `DPI_CONFIG` to control colour and display order for each DPI group. [← Gallery](../../index.html){.btn .btn-outline-secondary} [Download .ipynb](template.ipynb){.btn .btn-primary} --- ## User Configuration ::: {#user-config .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} # ── USER CONFIGURATION ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # Minimum read depth to retain a variant FILTER_MIN_DP = 500 # Minimum allele frequency to retain a variant (e.g. 0.01 = 1%) FILTER_MIN_AF = 0.01 # Paths to input data (relative to this file) LOFREQ_CSV = "data/LoFreq_variants.csv" IVAR_CSV = "data/iVar_variants.csv" GENE_COORDS = "data/gene_coords.csv" MANIFEST_CSV = "data/manifest.csv" # DPI group configuration — colours must match Okabe-Ito palette DPI_CONFIG = { 1: {"label": "DPI 1", "color": "#E69F00"}, 3: {"label": "DPI 3", "color": "#56B4E9"}, 5: {"label": "DPI 5", "color": "#009E73"}, } # Output directory for plots OUTPUT_DIR = "outputs" # Sliding-window size for entropy curves (genomic positions) WINDOW_SIZE = 200 # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ``` ::: ## Setup ::: {#setup .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} import os import warnings import numpy as np import pandas as pd import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from scipy.stats import entropy from collections import defaultdict warnings.filterwarnings("ignore") # ── Global plot theme: white background, no grid, black spine, Arial ───────── plt.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "sans-serif", "font.sans-serif": ["Arial", "Helvetica", "DejaVu Sans"], "axes.facecolor": "white", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.grid": False, "axes.edgecolor": "black", "axes.linewidth": 1.0, "axes.spines.top": True, "axes.spines.right": True, "axes.titlesize": 12, "axes.labelsize": 10, "xtick.labelsize": 9, "ytick.labelsize": 9, "legend.fontsize": 9, "figure.dpi": 150, }) pd.set_option("display.width", 1000) os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True) print(f"Output will be saved to: {os.path.abspath(OUTPUT_DIR)}") # ── Okabe-Ito palette helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────── OKABE_ITO = { "orange": "#E69F00", "sky_blue": "#56B4E9", "bluish_green": "#009E73", "amber": "#F5C710", "blue": "#0072B2", "vermillion": "#D55E00", "reddish_purple": "#CC79A7", "black": "#000000", } DPI_COLORS = {dpi: cfg["color"] for dpi, cfg in DPI_CONFIG.items()} DPI_LABELS = {dpi: cfg["label"] for dpi, cfg in DPI_CONFIG.items()} DPI_ORDER = sorted(DPI_CONFIG.keys()) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Output will be saved to: \Documents\GitHub_Repos\lab-bioinfo-templates\templates\11_variant-entropy-analysis\outputs ``` ::: ::: ## Load Data ::: {#cell-load-data .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} manifest = pd.read_csv(MANIFEST_CSV) print(f"Manifest: {len(manifest)} samples") print(manifest.head(), "\n") gene_coords = pd.read_csv(GENE_COORDS) print(f"Gene coordinates: {len(gene_coords)} genes") print(gene_coords.head(), "\n") lofreq_raw = pd.read_csv(LOFREQ_CSV) ivar_raw = pd.read_csv(IVAR_CSV) print(f"LoFreq: {len(lofreq_raw)} variants") print(f"iVar: {len(ivar_raw)} variants") for df, name in [(lofreq_raw, "LoFreq"), (ivar_raw, "iVar")]: missing = {"AF", "DP", "POS", "sample_id", "dpi"} - set(df.columns) if missing: raise ValueError(f"{name} CSV is missing required columns: {missing}") # Merge variant data into a single DataFrame with a 'caller' column lofreq_raw["caller"] = "LoFreq" ivar_raw["caller"] = "iVar" all_vars = pd.concat([lofreq_raw, ivar_raw], ignore_index=True) # Attach DPI from manifest if "dpi" not in all_vars.columns: dpi_map = dict(zip(manifest["sample_id"], manifest["dpi"])) all_vars["dpi"] = all_vars["sample_id"].map(dpi_map) print(f"\nCombined: {len(all_vars)} total variants") all_vars.head() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Manifest: 9 samples sample_id dpi replicate tissue 0 DPI1_R1_Lung 1 1 Lung 1 DPI1_R2_Lung 1 2 Lung 2 DPI1_R3_Lung 1 3 Lung 3 DPI3_R1_Lung 3 1 Lung 4 DPI3_R2_Lung 3 2 Lung Gene coordinates: 9 genes gene start end 0 nsp1 1 1800 1 nsp2 1801 4500 2 nsp3 4501 5700 3 nsp4 5701 7500 4 capsid 7501 8300 LoFreq: 1057 variants iVar: 828 variants Combined: 1885 total variants ``` ::: ::: {#load-data .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ## Quality Control: Depth & Frequency Filtering ::: {#qc-filter .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} pre = len(all_vars) all_vars = all_vars[ (all_vars["DP"] >= FILTER_MIN_DP) & (all_vars["AF"] >= FILTER_MIN_AF) ].copy() print(f"Retained {len(all_vars)} / {pre} variants " f"(DP ≥ {FILTER_MIN_DP}, AF ≥ {FILTER_MIN_AF})") # Assign variant classification for plotting def classify_variant(row): if row.get("consequence", "") == "missense_variant": return "missense" elif row.get("gene", "") == "intergenic": return "intergenic" else: return "synonymous/other" all_vars["variant_class"] = all_vars.apply(classify_variant, axis=1) print(all_vars["variant_class"].value_counts().to_string()) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Retained 1885 / 1885 variants (DP ≥ 500, AF ≥ 0.01) variant_class missense 1254 synonymous/other 624 intergenic 7 ``` ::: ::: ## 1. Variant Frequency Scatter Genomic position on the x-axis, log10(allele frequency) on the y-axis, with gene boundaries as vertical spans and DPI as colour. ::: {#plot-variant-scatter .cell fig-height='5' fig-width='14' execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} from matplotlib.patches import Patch # Define marker shapes per variant class class_styles = { "missense": {"marker": "o", "s": 18, "edgecolors": "black", "linewidths": 0.3}, "synonymous/other": {"marker": "s", "s": 14, "edgecolors": "black", "linewidths": 0.3}, "intergenic": {"marker": "^", "s": 16, "edgecolors": "black", "linewidths": 0.3}, } gene_colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(gene_coords))) for caller in ["LoFreq", "iVar"]: fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 5), constrained_layout=True) cdf = all_vars[all_vars["caller"] == caller] for dpi in DPI_ORDER: sub = cdf[cdf["dpi"] == dpi] for vclass, style in class_styles.items(): pts = sub[sub["variant_class"] == vclass] if pts.empty: continue ax.scatter( pts["POS"], pts["AF"], c=DPI_COLORS[dpi], marker=style["marker"], s=style["s"], edgecolors=style["edgecolors"], linewidths=style["linewidths"], alpha=0.7, label=f"{DPI_LABELS[dpi]} — {vclass}" if dpi == DPI_ORDER[0] else "", zorder=2, ) # Gene boundary spans for (_, gene_row), gc in zip(gene_coords.iterrows(), gene_colors): ax.axvspan( gene_row["start"], gene_row["end"], alpha=0.08, color=gc, zorder=0, label=gene_row["gene"], ) ax.set_yscale("log") ax.set_ylabel("Allele Frequency (log scale)") ax.set_xlabel("Genomic Position (nt)") ax.set_title(f"Variant Frequency — {caller}") ax.set_xlim(1, max(cdf["POS"].max(), gene_coords["end"].max())) # Deduplicated legend handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels() by_label = dict(zip(labels, handles)) ax.legend(by_label.values(), by_label.keys(), loc="upper left", fontsize=7, ncol=2, frameon=False) out_svg = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f"variant_scatter_{caller}.svg") out_png = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f"variant_scatter_{caller}.png") fig.savefig(out_svg, format="svg", bbox_inches="tight") fig.savefig(out_png, format="png", bbox_inches="tight", dpi=150) plt.show() print(f"Saved: {out_svg}, {out_png}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](template_files/figure-html/plot-variant-scatter-output-1.png){#plot-variant-scatter-1 width=2117 height=767} ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Saved: outputs\variant_scatter_LoFreq.svg, outputs\variant_scatter_LoFreq.png ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](template_files/figure-html/plot-variant-scatter-output-3.png){#plot-variant-scatter-2 width=2117 height=767} ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Saved: outputs\variant_scatter_iVar.svg, outputs\variant_scatter_iVar.png ``` ::: ::: ## 2. Shannon Entropy Curves per DPI Sliding-window Shannon entropy computed genome-wide. A separate curve (mean ± SEM) is drawn for each DPI group so that entropy accumulation can be compared through the course of infection. ::: {#cell-entropy-curves .cell fig-height='5' fig-width='14' execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} SEM_ALPHA = 0.20 def shannon_entropy(af_values): """Binary Shannon entropy (natural log) for a list of variant AFs. Expects AFs as float.""" vals = np.asarray(af_values, dtype=float) ref_freq = 1.0 - vals ent = -(vals * np.log(vals + 1e-300) + ref_freq * np.log(ref_freq + 1e-300)) return ent # Build position-indexed dictionary per DPI # Key: dpi → dict of {position: [AF values across replicates]} genome_len = int(gene_coords["end"].max()) entropy_data = {dpi: {pos: [] for pos in range(1, genome_len + 1)} for dpi in DPI_ORDER} for _, row in all_vars.iterrows(): dpi = row["dpi"] pos = row["POS"] if dpi in entropy_data and 1 <= pos <= genome_len: entropy_data[dpi][pos].append(row["AF"]) # Sliding window (windows are overlapping — step = 1 for smoothness) half = WINDOW_SIZE // 2 dpi_curves = {} for dpi in DPI_ORDER: pos_dict = entropy_data[dpi] x_positions = [] y_means = [] y_sems = [] for center in range(half + 1, genome_len - half + 1): window_afs = [] for wp in range(center - half, center + half): window_afs.extend(pos_dict.get(wp, [])) if len(window_afs) < 2: continue window_ent = shannon_entropy(window_afs) x_positions.append(center) y_means.append(np.mean(window_ent)) y_sems.append(np.std(window_ent, ddof=1) / np.sqrt(len(window_afs))) dpi_curves[dpi] = (np.array(x_positions), np.array(y_means), np.array(y_sems)) # Plot fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 5), constrained_layout=True) for dpi in DPI_ORDER: if dpi not in dpi_curves: continue x_pos, y_mean, y_sem = dpi_curves[dpi] ax.plot(x_pos, y_mean, color=DPI_COLORS[dpi], linewidth=1.2, label=DPI_LABELS[dpi]) ax.fill_between(x_pos, y_mean - y_sem, y_mean + y_sem, color=DPI_COLORS[dpi], alpha=SEM_ALPHA, linewidth=0) for (_, gene_row), gc in zip(gene_coords.iterrows(), gene_colors): ax.axvspan( gene_row["start"], gene_row["end"], alpha=0.08, color=gc, zorder=0, ) ax.set_xlim(1, genome_len) ax.set_xlabel("Genomic Position (nt)") ax.set_ylabel("Shannon Entropy (nat)") ax.set_title(f"Genome-Wide Shannon Entropy (sliding window = {WINDOW_SIZE} nt)") ax.legend(loc="upper right", frameon=False) out_svg = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "entropy_curves.svg") out_png = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "entropy_curves.png") fig.savefig(out_svg, format="svg", bbox_inches="tight") fig.savefig(out_png, format="png", bbox_inches="tight", dpi=150) plt.show() print(f"Saved: {out_svg}, {out_png}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](template_files/figure-html/entropy-curves-output-1.png){#entropy-curves width=2117 height=767} ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Saved: outputs\entropy_curves.svg, outputs\entropy_curves.png ``` ::: ::: ## 3. LoFreq vs iVar Caller Overlap (Venn) Shared variant positions between LoFreq and iVar, per DPI group. Uses `matplotlib_venn` if installed; otherwise prints a contingency table. ::: {#caller-venn .cell fig-height='4' fig-width='10' execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} lofreq_positions = { dpi: set(all_vars[(all_vars["caller"] == "LoFreq") & (all_vars["dpi"] == dpi)]["POS"]) for dpi in DPI_ORDER } ivar_positions = { dpi: set(all_vars[(all_vars["caller"] == "iVar") & (all_vars["dpi"] == dpi)]["POS"]) for dpi in DPI_ORDER } try: from matplotlib_venn import venn2 n_dpis = len(DPI_ORDER) fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, n_dpis, figsize=(n_dpis * 3.5, 3.5), constrained_layout=True) if n_dpis == 1: axes = [axes] for ax, dpi in zip(axes, DPI_ORDER): lf_set = lofreq_positions.get(dpi, set()) iv_set = ivar_positions.get(dpi, set()) v = venn2( subsets=(len(lf_set - iv_set), len(iv_set - lf_set), len(lf_set & iv_set)), set_labels=("LoFreq", "iVar"), ax=ax, ) if v.get_label_by_id("10"): v.get_label_by_id("10").set_text(len(lf_set - iv_set)) if v.get_label_by_id("01"): v.get_label_by_id("01").set_text(len(iv_set - lf_set)) if v.get_label_by_id("11"): v.get_label_by_id("11").set_text(len(lf_set & iv_set)) # Apply Okabe-Ito colours to the diagram for patch_id, color in [("10", OKABE_ITO["orange"]), ("01", OKABE_ITO["bluish_green"])]: p = v.get_patch_by_id(patch_id) if p: p.set_color(color) p.set_alpha(0.5) ax.set_title(DPI_LABELS[dpi]) out_svg = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "caller_overlap_venn.svg") out_png = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "caller_overlap_venn.png") fig.savefig(out_svg, format="svg", bbox_inches="tight") fig.savefig(out_png, format="png", bbox_inches="tight", dpi=150) plt.show() print(f"Saved: {out_svg}, {out_png}") except ImportError: print( "matplotlib_venn is not installed — printing overlap contingency table instead.\n" "Install with: pip install matplotlib-venn" ) rows = [] for dpi in DPI_ORDER: lf = lofreq_positions.get(dpi, set()) iv = ivar_positions.get(dpi, set()) rows.append({ "DPI": dpi, "LoFreq only": len(lf - iv), "iVar only": len(iv - lf), "Shared": len(lf & iv), "Total union": len(lf | iv), }) overlap_df = pd.DataFrame(rows) overlap_df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "caller_overlap_summary.csv"), index=False) print("Saved: caller_overlap_summary.csv") print(overlap_df.to_string(index=False)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` matplotlib_venn is not installed — printing overlap contingency table instead. Install with: pip install matplotlib-venn Saved: caller_overlap_summary.csv DPI LoFreq only iVar only Shared Total union 1 142 118 1 261 3 361 255 9 625 5 510 419 22 951 ``` ::: ::: ## Summary: Variant Counts per DPI per Caller ::: {#summary-table .cell execution_count=8} ``` {.python .cell-code} summary = ( all_vars .groupby(["dpi", "caller"])["POS"] .count() .unstack(fill_value=0) ) summary.columns.name = None summary.index.name = "DPI" # Add variant-class breakdown class_summary = ( all_vars .groupby(["dpi", "variant_class"])["POS"] .count() .unstack(fill_value=0) ) print("=== Variants per DPI per Caller ===") print(summary.to_string()) print(f"\nSaved {len(all_vars)} filtered variants to memory; " f"CSV inputs from data/ directory.") summary.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "variant_summary_by_caller.csv")) class_summary.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "variant_summary_by_class.csv")) print("Saved: variant_summary_by_caller.csv, variant_summary_by_class.csv") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` === Variants per DPI per Caller === LoFreq iVar DPI 1 143 119 3 375 267 5 539 442 Saved 1885 filtered variants to memory; CSV inputs from data/ directory. Saved: variant_summary_by_caller.csv, variant_summary_by_class.csv ``` ::: :::
